name: Bandage roll
summary: White gauze bandage roll with a partly unrolled tail; anim unroll pays the tail out. For first aid and injury scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the roll rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 about 600 px wide and 300 px tall; use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: unroll = the tail pays out over 90 frames and the roll turns

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror: tail runs to the left

author: krakujs
